content.comment_body: Hello, We tried connecting our [product_name] to a PC using a cable which I believe has article number [article_no], but it's an older device and I'm not sure if that's correct. Could you provide details about the pin connections or share a link to the schematic for this cable? Thank you, [user_name]

The cable with article number [article_no] is the correct one. With this cable, you can connect to any [product_name]. Please use the serial com port on your PC; if you need to use USB (for PCs without a serial port), you can use a converter as described in this FAQ: [url]. Always ensure no other program is blocking the com port by closing any software that might be using it.
A new question was split to 'Connect [product_name] [article_no] via USB cable [article_no]'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are looking for accurate, up-to-date instructions for connecting a specific automation module to a PC, and express uncertainty due to outdated cable identification. This reveals a need for clearer documentation regarding hardware connectivity and compatibility. Tips were also given on considering the type of PC ports and ensuring software does not block communication.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear guidance on correct cable selection, pin configuration, and feasible adapter solutions for connecting legacy automation devices to modern PCs.
